v2_findings.prior_finding: P2-1 terminal BOUND row aggregation bypass
v2_findings.evidence: The batch aggregator is renamed _aggregate_bound_stations, removed from __all__, and explicitly marks aggregation_scope as internal_station_status_aggregation_only_not_external_source_authentication. The public high-level builder validates package hashes and STEP-bound wall-reference input before emitting a top-level report.
v2_findings.residual: A caller deliberately importing the private helper can still aggregate a forged terminal row to PASS; that output is explicitly scoped as unauthenticated internal aggregation.

v2_findings.prior_finding: P2-2 bool accepted as a tessellation policy number
v2_findings.evidence: All six manifest/report sources reject bool and non-Real, then require finite positive values and angular values below pi. BindingPolicy validates its five fields and finite derived thresholds.

public_station_helper.name: bind_station_to_parent_mesh
public_station_helper.precondition_documented: The station was already rechecked against the canonical STEP B-rep face.
public_station_helper.assessment: Can return a local BOUND row when called directly with caller-provided inputs that violate the documented precondition; does not itself emit PASS_MOTHER_STATION_BINDING or any qualification object. This is a low-level primitive and does not provide a higher qualification status.
